user.title: Quarter-hour peak guard
user.description: Keeps the average grid import of every quarter hour below a limit (power-based grid tariffs). Devices are added afterwards under Configure.

data_description.grid_power: Sensor with the power drawn from the grid (W or kW). Negative values (export) count as 0.
data_description.grid_energy: Optional but recommended: the meter's import counter. Makes the quarter-hour energy exact after restarts.
data_description.limit_kw: The quarter-hour average that must not be exceeded.
data_description.margin_kw: The guard aims at limit minus margin.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one guard can be set up.

init.title: General settings
init.description: Devices are added, changed and deleted on the integration page (Add / ⋮ next to each device).

data_description.condition_entity: Optional. The guard only intervenes while this entity is on (e.g. a template that is on when the car may charge from the grid). Off: everything is given back.
data_description.lock_entity: Optional. While this is on, active mode is refused and the guard only observes (e.g. an older guard that is still running).
data_description.notify_services: Optional, comma-separated, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Used when the limit cannot be held.
data_description.startup_mode: Restore = the mode it had before the restart.

user.title: Wallbox
user.description: The charging current is reduced step by step, if allowed down to 1 phase. Charging is never stopped.

data_description.priority: 1 = restricted first, 10 = only when nothing else helps.
data_description.phase_entity: Optional. Without it the wallbox is only throttled, never switched to 1 phase.
data_description.one_phase_option: Exact option text of the phase selection for 1 phase, e.g. 1 Phase.
data_description.phases_entity: Optional sensor with the number of phases currently used.
data_description.allow_entity: Optional. Only while this entity is on.

reconfigure.title: Wallbox
reconfigure.description: The charging current is reduced step by step, if allowed down to 1 phase. Charging is never stopped.

data_description.priority: 1 = restricted first, 10 = only when nothing else helps.
data_description.phase_entity: Optional. Without it the wallbox is only throttled, never switched to 1 phase.
data_description.one_phase_option: Exact option text of the phase selection for 1 phase, e.g. 1 Phase.
data_description.phases_entity: Optional sensor with the number of phases currently used.
data_description.allow_entity: Optional. Only while this entity is on.

error.min_above_max: Minimum current is above maximum current.
error.phase_pair: Phase selection and option for 1 phase belong together.
error.unknown_option: The phase selection has no such option.

user.title: Switchable device
user.description: Switched off when needed and on again when there is room. Only devices the guard switched off are switched on again.

data_description.priority: 1 = restricted first, 10 = only when nothing else helps.
data_description.max_off_min: 0 = no limit. After this time the device is switched on again in any case.
data_description.restore_entity: Optional, e.g. a template that is on while the device's own schedule wants it on.

reconfigure.title: Switchable device
reconfigure.description: Switched off when needed and on again when there is room. Only devices the guard switched off are switched on again.

data_description.priority: 1 = restricted first, 10 = only when nothing else helps.
data_description.max_off_min: 0 = no limit. After this time the device is switched on again in any case.
data_description.restore_entity: Optional, e.g. a template that is on while the device's own schedule wants it on.

user.title: Emergency action
user.description: A script that lowers the grid import, e.g. releases the home battery. A second script undoes it.

data_description.allow_entity: Optional, e.g. a template that is on while the battery is above its minimum charge.

reconfigure.description: A script that lowers the grid import, e.g. releases the home battery. A second script undoes it.

data_description.allow_entity: Optional, e.g. a template that is on while the battery is above its minimum charge.
